parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hello, Move It Shipping.

Hi, I'd like a few more details about your services please.

Certainly.

I've been on your website looking into sending some things abroad when I go away to study next term. I see that you provide special empty boxes so that I can pack them myself and you then transport them.

That's right. We provide those free of charge.

And can I ask what goods you can transport? Like, do you take electrical goods?

Well, it depends. If you've got something like a computer, that's fine. But things like washing machines and fridges are too heavy and bulky for our service.

No, I wouldn't be taking that sort of stuff.

You can always check with us if there's anything you're not sure about including.

I was wondering about my bicycle. I suppose that'd be too bulky.

No, that's fine, though we wouldn't be able to take a motorbike.

Sure. Is there anything else you don't take?

Well, basically, the service is restricted to what one man can lift, so 40 kilogrammes is the maximum for each package. We do have a list of particular things we can't transport on our website, but I'll tell you the main points. So, in order to comply with security regulations, we don't take any sort of liquids, and we also don't accept any type of foods. And if you provide your own containers, rather than using ours, we only allow certain types.

So, can I use cardboard containers?

Yes, they're OK if they're strong enough, but we won't carry things that have been packed in plastic containers. They crack and break so easily that our policy is simply not to take them.

Fine. And once I've packed everything, you can collect my things from my home and deliver them to wherever I live abroad, is that right?

Yes, and we do have some special services. For example, we can make special arrangements to deliver on Saturdays if that's more convenient for you. Or, if you're in a hurry, we have an express delivery option. There's a surcharge for these services, of course, but it's very reasonable.

OK, I'll keep that in mind. And what happens if the delivery can't be made for some reason, like if I haven't finalised my accommodation? Can you keep my stuff for me for a few days?

Yes, we can arrange storage, though again there would be an extra charge for that.

Sure.

And can you give me an idea of your prices?

Of course. Roughly how much would you want transported?

Say, for example, I had 15 boxes, and I’ve also got a violin. That would need packing with special care, I think.

OK.

And it would be collection in the UK?

Yes.

And Sweden would be the destination.

OK, I’ll do a quick calculation. Let me just get that up on the screen. Fifteen boxes, and one special package. Let’s see. It’d be something in the order of £575.

Right. And how would I pay that?

Well, you can pay by debit or credit card over the phone, or if you prefer to pay in cash, you can just give it to the driver when he arrives to collect your belongings, and he’ll give you a receipt.

Fine.

And at the same time, you’ll need to hand over some documentation, so you’ll need a copy of your passport.

A photocopy?

That’s right. So make sure you get that done in advance, and have it ready with you. Then there are also some papers you’ll need that we’ll send you in advance, so that you can get them completed in good time. The most important ones are the insurance documents, so you need to have filled in all the...

analyses.content: 录音中男生问自行车能不能托运，女生明确回答“that's fine”表示可以。

I was wondering about my bicycle. I suppose that'd be too bulky.
No, that's fine, though we wouldn't be able to take a motorbike.
你可能会听到紧接着的“motorbike”就赶紧写下来，但人家马上补了一句“wouldn't be able to take”（不能运），一定要把整句话听完整。
Well, basically, the service is restricted to what one man can lift, so 40 kilogrammes is the maximum for each package.
你可能会因为没听到卷面上的“weighing”而犹豫，但录音里的“40公斤是上限”和卷子上的“重量超过多少不能运”说的是同一回事。
录音明确提到每个包裹的最大重量是40公斤。
So, in order to comply with security regulations, we don't take any sort of liquids, and we also don't accept any type of foods.
你可能会漏听单词结尾的复数“s”，填空题听到复数必须写完整，否则会白白扣分。
录音说为了符合安全规定，他们不接受任何种类的液体（liquids）。

So, can I use cardboard containers?
Yes, they're OK if they're strong enough, but we won't carry things that have been packed in plastic containers.
你可能听到前面的“cardboard（纸板）”就急着填了，但录音说纸板箱是可以的（they're OK），别忘了题目问的是“不运”哪种材料。
录音中女生明确说，他们不运那些装在塑料（plastic）容器里的东西。
Yes, and we do have some special services. For example, we can make special arrangements to deliver on Saturdays if that's more convenient for you.
星期几的首字母必须大写，而且录音里明确读了复数尾音“s”，漏写大写或单复数都会被判错。
录音提到为了方便，可以特别安排在星期六（Saturdays）送货。
录音里男生问能不能帮忙保管几天东西，女生回答说可以安排存储（storage）。

And what happens if the delivery can't be made for some reason, like if I haven't finalised my accommodation? Can you keep my stuff for me for a few days?
Yes, we can arrange storage, though again there would be an extra charge for that.
卷面上的“organisation of”对应的就是录音里的“arrange”，你可能会死等卷面上的词出现，从而错过了答案“storage”。

And it would be collection in the UK?
Yes.
And Sweden would be the destination.
这道题给得很直接，但如果你对国家名称拼写不熟练，或者忘了首字母要大写，就会比较可惜。
录音中男生直接说明了目的地是瑞典（Sweden）。
OK, I’ll do a quick calculation. Let me just get that up on the screen. Fifteen boxes, and one special package. Let’s see. It’d be something in the order of £575.
数字听写是纯基本功，只要别把“575”听岔或者写错位就行。
录音里女生算了一下，直接给出了575（英镑）的预估总价。
Well, you can pay by debit or credit card over the phone, or if you prefer to pay in cash, you can just give it to the driver when he arrives to collect your belongings, and he’ll give you a receipt.
语速一快，你可能没把录音里的“give it to”和卷面上的“in cash to”联系起来，导致答案滑了过去。
录音告诉你如果想付现金，直接把钱给来取件的司机（driver）就行。

And at the same time, you’ll need to hand over some documentation, so you’ll need a copy of your passport.
A photocopy?
That’s right.
录音是先说了答案“passport”，紧接着才说了卷面上的“photocopy”，你可能会因为一直等卷面词而没反应过来答案其实已经讲过了。
录音中女生要求提供护照（passport）复印件，男生随后确认了。
